winning_hook_formulas: The 'Counter-Intuitive Warning': Stop [Common Action] before you check [Specific Metric/Data Point].
The 'Hidden Loss' Reveal: Your [Common Financial Instrument] is secretly [Negative Outcome] every single day.
script_directives: Keep duration strictly between 20-22 seconds to maximize completion rates.
Eliminate all preamble; start the video with the hook and immediately transition to the 'why' within the first 3 seconds.
Use high-contrast visual cues (charts or red/green indicators) to emphasize the financial 'trap' or 'opportunity' mentioned in the hook.
seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title that address specific investor fears (e.g., 'Trap', 'Stop', 'Loss', 'Discount').
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant tags that define the niche (e.g., #StockMarketIndia #PersonalFinance #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithmic dilution.
